name: Kinoshita Kirara
source:
A junior who is enrolled in the same drama club as Kohaku. She is in the C-class in the first year. 

Kirara is a human world enthusiast who was born in the god world and raised in the demon world.
She joined the drama club because of her admiration for Kohaku but is now beginning to develop her talent as a screenwriter.
She does not dislike Raito (in fact, she likes him), but at the moment she is too occupied with the performance at the festival to spare time for him.

Motto: "One rotten apple spoils the barrel."

Likes: the human world, humans, fashion, good-looking people, Kohaku-senpai
Dislikes: people who say badly about their parents or hometown.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/character.html]official website[/url]]
